status: Passed at b300bea on release binaries built from the committed source (state schema 23), against this Mac's real Chrome profile and the real `claude --chrome-native-host` bridge (pid 1072): `runtimes` lists `claude-browser` as `Claude in Chrome 1.0.93` with the sentence that its sessions run in the browser and cannot be listed, messaged or leased for; `discover` lists the five real Claude/Codex sessions and never the bridge; `adopt 1072` is refused with `pid 1072 is Claude Code's bridge for the browser extension, not a session; there is nothing to adopt` both without a runtime and with `--runtime claude-code`; `rm` on a live external record says to `deregister --as` instead of `stop`, after which `deregister` and `rm` succeed; `setup claude-browser --dry-run` says there is nothing on this machine to set up. The side-panel agent itself remains unrepresented: nothing local speaks for it, and this record establishes only that AgentDocker now says so instead of showing a phantom.
scope: Vendor-neutral inventory of browser-extension agents (Claude, ChatGPT; per Chromium-family profile, bridge matched by allowed_origins), refusal to adopt a known runtime's helper processes, and the rm/deregister wording, on release binaries in a private AGENTDOCKER_HOME. ChatGPT's extension is not installed on this machine, so its row reads not installed; Linux and Windows profile layouts are covered by unit tests only. The desktop Tools row is covered by UI unit tests, not a rendered capture.
method: scripts: a private home under the session scratchpad, `agentd` started from the release directory with AGENTDOCKER_NO_AUTOSTART=1, then in order: `agentd --build-info`, `ps` on the bridge pid, `agentdocker runtimes`, `discover`, `adopt 1072`, `adopt 1072 --runtime claude-code`, `ps -a`, `register --name external-trial --pid <sleep>` followed by `rm external-trial` (refused), `deregister --as external-trial`, `rm external-trial`, and `setup claude-browser --dry-run`; the daemon was then stopped. The machine's real Chrome profile (`~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/Default`) holds the Claude extension fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn 1.0.93 and a NativeMessagingHosts manifest naming it, installed by Claude Code, whose bridge process has run since login.
gate: bash scripts/verify.sh check on the same tree before the commit: 1,172 Rust tests (seven skipped), 94 Python checks (one skipped), formatting, strict Clippy, doctests, packaging and the release build passed.

runtimes_note: Claude (browser extension) is installed in the browser. Sessions in the browser run there and on the vendor's side; nothing on this machine speaks for them, so AgentDocker cannot list, message or lease for them. A bridge the browser launches for a command-line tool is that tool's helper, not a session, and adopting it is refused.
